name: Logrosán (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Logrosán (fleurs-de-lis on blue above a castle) between four yellow fleurs-de-lis in the corners.
history: Municipal flag of Logrosán; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Logrosán arms — fleurs-de-lis above a castle
